app.name: Saver
app.tagline: Your expenses, savings and investments in one place

auth.demoWarningText: This app is an experimental demo developed with low-budget resources and practices. It is strongly recommended NOT to enter real personal or financial data. Any registered account information is the sole responsibility of the user.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent an email with the link.
auth.forgotSentHint: Check your spam folder too. The link expires in 30 minutes.
auth.resetDone: Done! Your password changed. For security, we signed you out of other devices.

dashboard.empty: Add your income and expenses to see this month's balance.

notifications.title: Customize notifications
notifications.intro: Choose which alerts you want and how to receive them.
notifications.deliveryNote: Preferences are saved to your account. Email delivery and browser push notifications will be enabled in a later stage.

OVERDUE.title: Overdue bill
OVERDUE.description: Notify when a bill remains unpaid after its due date.

auth.email_taken: An account with that email already exists
auth.password_length: Password must be 8 to 72 characters long
auth.google_invalid_token: We couldn't validate your Google account
auth.google_email_not_verified: Your Google email is not verified
auth.unauthorized: Your session expired, please sign in again
auth.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action
auth.refresh_missing: Your session expired, please sign in again
auth.refresh_invalid: Your session expired, please sign in again
auth.refresh_expired: Your session expired, please sign in again
auth.reset_invalid: The link is invalid or was already used

validation.failed: Please check the data you entered

category.name_taken: You already have a category with that name
category.deleted: That category was deleted; pick another

income.adjust_only_recurring: Increases only apply to repeating income
income.has_receipts: The income has recorded receipts: end it or delete the receipts first

expense.adjust_only_recurring: Increases only apply to monthly fixed expenses
expense.end_only_recurring: Only monthly fixed expenses can be ended
expense.has_payments: It has recorded payments: use “End” instead of deleting
expense.past_months_choice_required: Say whether the previous months are already paid

projection.invalid_months: The horizon must be 1 to 120 months

timeline.invalid_from: The start month is too far away

account.has_movements: The account has movements: archive it instead of deleting it
account.adjustment_zero: The real balance equals the current one

card.not_found: The card doesn't exist or is archived

receipt.month_inactive: The income doesn't apply to that month

exchange.rate_required: No stored dollar rate: enter it manually

attachment.invalid_type: Only PDF, PNG, JPEG or WEBP are accepted
attachment.too_large: Each file can be up to 10 MB

categories.name: Name
categories.deleteHint: A deleted category is no longer offered for new expenses, but history keeps it.
categories.deleteMessage: Delete “{{name}}”? Expenses that already use it will keep showing it.

expenses.editOccurrenceHint: Changes this month only (e.g. the actual bill amount or a different due date).
expenses.variableHint: E.g. electricity or gas. Enter an estimate and adjust the real amount each month.
expenses.adjustHint: E.g. rent goes up every 4 months. Used to estimate future months.
expenses.emptyTemplates: You haven't added any expenses yet.
expenses.changeAmountHint: Applies from the chosen month and is kept in history. Previous months don't change.
expenses.endHint: The expense stops appearing after the chosen month.
expenses.deleteMessage: Delete “{{name}}” and all its months or installments? To keep history, use “End”.

pastMonths.question_one: It starts last month. Is that month already paid?
pastMonths.question_other: It starts {{count}} months ago. Are the previous months already paid?
pastMonths.hint: If you already paid them they're marked as paid (no account or receipt) and don't show as overdue.
pastMonths.no: No, they stay pending (shown as overdue)

incomes.intro: Fixed income (salary) and repeating extras are used to project the following months. One-month extras are not.
incomes.empty: You haven't added any income yet.
incomes.changeAmountHint: E.g. a salary raise. Applies from the chosen month; earlier months don't change.
incomes.endHint: The income stops counting after the chosen month.
incomes.deleteMessage: Delete “{{name}}”? It also disappears from previous months.
incomes.repeatHint: If each month's amount is different, enter each payment as “This month only”.
incomes.adjustHint: E.g. the salary increases every 3 months with inflation. Used to estimate future months.

history.empty: No data in this period. History is built from the income and expenses you entered.
history.savingsHint: Income − all expenses of the month
history.compareHint: What changed between the chosen month and {{to}}
history.averageSince_other: Average savings since {{from}}: {{amount}} per month ({{count}} months).
history.noExpensesToCompare: No expenses to compare in those months.
history.realToggleHint: Each month's amounts are brought to the last month of the period so they can be compared fairly.
history.expensesAboveInflation: Your expenses rose {{pct}} more than inflation.
history.expensesBelowInflation: Your expenses rose {{pct}} less than inflation.
history.expensesLikeInflation: Your expenses rose in line with inflation.
history.savingsRealCompare: Savings in {{from}} are worth {{amount}} in {{to}} money:

projections.intro: How much you'll have in the coming months keeping your current income and expenses, with installments ending and estimated increases.
projections.startBalanceHint: Optional: added to the projected savings
projections.inflationHint: Empty = the currency's inflation. A value only changes this simulation.
projections.excludedCurrencies: You have activity in {{list}} that isn't included: the projection is in {{currency}} only.
projections.negativeMonths_one: {{count}} month has more expenses than income.
projections.negativeMonths_other: {{count}} months have more expenses than income.
projections.noInflation: No inflation set for this currency
projections.cumulativeHint: Money available today + each month's savings
projections.monthlyHint: Includes estimated increases and the average of variable expenses

inflationSource.ESTIMATED: average of the latest official months

adjustment.inflationHint_one: Increases by the previous month's inflation per {{source}}. Months without data use the estimated inflation.
adjustment.inflationHint_other: Increases by the inflation of the previous {{count}} months per {{source}}. Months without data use the estimated inflation.

inflation.title: Inflation
inflation.intro: Downloaded once a day from official sources and used in projections, in expenses and income that increase with inflation, and to see history in real terms. Months without official data use your manual inflation or, if you did not set one, the average of the latest months.
inflation.noData: No official data yet. It downloads automatically when the server has internet access; meanwhile you can enter a manual inflation rate.

projected.ESTIMATED_other: average of the last {{count}} official months

inflation.manualHint: Optional. Replaces the estimate only for months that do not have official data yet.
inflation.recentChart: Monthly inflation of the latest months

timeline.title: Income and expenses: past and projection
timeline.hint: Earlier months are actual; from the current month on, projected (lighter).

accounts.intro: Where your money is: banks, wallets, cash, savings and investments. Payments come out of an account and income goes into one.
accounts.empty: You haven't added any accounts yet. Create at least one to record payments and income.
accounts.noneYet: You need an account to record movements.
accounts.noRate: The dollar rate is missing to add up both currencies
accounts.openingHint: What the account holds today. Movements before that date don't change the balance.
accounts.beforeOpening: before the opening balance, doesn't count
accounts.adjustHint: Balance in Saver: {{amount}}. Enter the real balance and the difference is recorded (interest, fees, missing expenses).
accounts.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? Only possible if it has no movements.
accounts.cannotDelete: The account has movements: archive it to hide it without losing history.
accounts.transferHint: Between accounts in different currencies it is buying or selling dollars (MEP dollar or the rate you enter).

kindHint.SAVINGS: What you set aside to save (e.g. dollars). Counts as savings.
kindHint.INVESTMENT: Time deposits, funds, stocks, crypto. Counts as savings.

cards.title: Cards
cards.intro: Used to group the expenses you pay with each card. Each installment is still paid separately.

rates.title: Dollar rates
rates.intro: Updated automatically from dolarapi.com. Each payment stores the rate used.
rates.none: No rates yet (they download when there is internet). Meanwhile you can enter the rate manually on each payment.

use.OFICIAL: USD expenses without a card and USD income
use.MEP: Buying/selling dollars and valuing your net worth

payments.title: Pay {{name}} · {{month}}
payments.withCard: Paid with {{card}}: from a peso account the card dollar rate is used.
payments.assumed: Marked as paid when the expense was added (no account)
payments.filesHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WEBP. Up to {{max}} files of 10 MB.
payments.deleteMessage: Delete the {{amount}} payment? Its receipts are deleted too and the money returns to the account.
payments.rateMissing: No stored rate: enter it manually.
payments.uploadFailed: The payment was recorded but the receipts couldn't be uploaded ({{reason}}). You can attach them from the payment.
